summary: The DGA radio group: native radio buttons sharing one name for choosing exactly one of a few visible options. A signal-model control: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field; null means nothing selected.

inputs.name: touched
inputs.description: Becomes true when focus leaves an option.

inputs.name: options
inputs.type: readonly DgaRadioOption[] ({ value, label, hint?, disabled? })
inputs.description: The options in order; label and hint are translated.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label (translated).

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the group invalid.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The native radio name; a unique one is generated when omitted.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Stacks the options or lays them out in a row.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Sets aria-required plus a decorative asterisk.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the group invalid without a message.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The newly selected value (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true when focus first leaves an option.

a11y: role=radiogroup named by the visible label (aria-labelledby) or ariaLabel, with aria-describedby, aria-required, aria-invalid and aria-disabled. Native radios give the standard keyboard: Tab enters the group, arrow keys move and select following the reading direction (RTL aware).
